name: Pink
source:
Pink. I like the color pink. It's simple, yet can be elegant or energetic. It can be whatever it wanted to be. I think if I was a color, I would be pink.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29914]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Created for [url=http://itch.io/jam/nanowinter2015]NaNoWinter 2015[/url].
translation:
粉色的。我喜欢粉红色。它很简单，但可以优雅或充满活力。它可以是任何它想成为的样子。我想如果我有一种颜色，我会是粉红色的。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29914]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
